precision_audit.metadata_note: Native records an additional torch_cpu_threads field. Author source explicitly sets2 but does not persist this field; seven shared precision fields match.

loss_comparison_scope: Each epoch loss is the equal-batch mean in both runners. Native example-weighted loss is intentionally not compared to the source equal-batch mean.
loss_precision_note: The author adds orth_loss inplace to FP32 CE; native out-of-place addition preserves float64 when old centroid means are present. Scalar loss can differ by float rounding even when clipped gradients match.
